text:
anya: Pushing a quick build of the compact notify row — screenshot + small interaction gif: https://redwood-internal.screenshots/notify-compact-v1.gif. main ask: does suppression state and severity remain discoverable when we go dense? mike: Looks good overall. Concern: severity chip contrast dips below AA at small sizes when on light backgrounds. can we bump contrast or add a 1px outline? leah: Agree on contrast. Also the suppression pill ("suppressed") is visually subtle. for screen readers it should be part of the main label, not a separate decorative badge. jordan: For SR announce order, I think users want context first: "Database Alerts, Critical, notifications suppressed, 2 previews" vs announcing severity first. We should test both orders with real users. ben: Implementation nit: if we include the preview count announce, use wording like "2 recent messages" rather than "2 previews". clearer. anya: Good point. Copy suggestion: label the little pill "suppressed" -> tooltip "notifications suppressed for this channel" and SR announce as "notifications suppressed". keep visual label short but aria text explicit. mike: For keyboard nav, the row currently tabs to the expand chevron and then menu. Recommend reverse: focus on the menu first (primary actions) then preview toggle. reduces cognitive overhead when scanning rows. leah: Hmm I worry moving menu first breaks expected left-to-right flow. Maybe keep menu last but make sure the toggle has a 0ms keypress handler so screen reader users don't experience delays when expanding preview. jordan: Accessibility test scope: VoiceOver (mac), NVDA (Windows), JAWS if possible, plus TalkBack on Android small-screen. Also test with high zoom and keyboard-only. ux-bot: Suggested markup pattern (auto): ```html
Critical Database Alerts
``` ux-bot: Notes: keep large announcement text inside aria-live container when preview opens; keep visual badges aria-hidden if they're duplicated in aria-label. ben: One more micro-copy: change overflow menu item "Snooze" to "Snooze notifications" and add a quick duration sublabel like "Snooze notifications — 1h" in the menu preview. anya: Agree. Also small UX ask: when rows are dense, hide per-row avatars and move them into group-by panels; avatars add noise. mike: Visual polish: try 2px higher line-height in dense mode to avoid clipping on some fonts at 120% zoom. leah: Accessibility checklist to include in the ticket: 1) severity contrast >= AA 2) suppression state included in aria-label as verb phrase 3) preview announced via aria-live only on expand 4) preview toggle reachable by keyboard w/ clear aria-expanded state 5) overflow menu keyboard order confirmed with team tests jordan: I'll schedule a quick 20min pairing session to run the checklist on VoiceOver + NVDA tomorrow. anya: Added acceptance criteria to INF-1342 and attached the Figma file. I'll prototype the aria-live container behavior in the dev sandbox and tag @jordan @ben for review. ux-bot: Prototype URL: https://redwood-internal.design/inf-1342/compact-row-proto (build 2026-03-21-a). mike: Thanks — small follow-up: please add a note to the ticket about prefers-reduced-motion for the preview expand animation. some SR users prefer no motion. anya: Done. will push an updated Figma and link the usability script after the pairing. thanks!
